messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- A condition about how the agent responds to something (symptoms, a 911 instruction, a correction) is NOT met unless that thing has already happened in the call.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hello honey, it's Gloria Hart. I need the water pill...
AGENT: Hi Gloria, thanks for calling Harbor Pharmacy! I'd be happy to help you with your water pill. Let me just verify your information first—can you give me your date of birth?
CALLER: Oh, my birthday's May 12th, 1947. And honey, wait - not the water pill, I meant the blood pressure one... lisinopril.
AGENT (LATEST): Got it, Gloria—so you need the lisinopril, your blood pressure medication. Let me pull up your prescriptions. Perfect, Gloria. Now let me see what lisinopril prescriptions you have on file. I found your lisinopril 10 mg, but it shows zero refills left. Would you like me to send a renewal request to Dr. Patel so you can get it refilled?  [system actions: verify_identity, list_prescriptions]

CONDITIONS:
move_1: the agent says lisinopril has no refills
asked_2: In its LATEST turn, the agent asks the caller something that this fact directly answers: "Has about a week of lisinopril left"
stop_0: Agent confirms a renewal request to Dr. Patel with a timeline.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"move_1": {"met": true, "why": "Agent states lisinopril shows zero refills left."}, "asked_2": {"met": false, "why": "Agent asks about renewal, not remaining supply."}, "stop_0": {"met": false, "why": "Renewal not yet confirmed, only proposed."}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency instruction."}}
